name: point-of-sale
description: Point of Sale — an open-source point-of-sale example app for cafes & restaurants, built with Vite + React + TypeScript.

scripts.build:surface:staff: VITE_ADMINIUM_SURFACE_SIDE=staff tsc -b && VITE_ADMINIUM_SURFACE_SIDE=staff vite build --base=/apps/pos/staff/ --outDir dist-surface/pos/staff
scripts.build:surface:customer: VITE_ADMINIUM_SURFACE_SIDE=customer tsc -b && VITE_ADMINIUM_SURFACE_SIDE=customer vite build --base=/apps/pos/customer/ --outDir dist-surface/pos/customer
scripts.build:surface: npm run build:surface:staff && npm run build:surface:customer
